- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py; _shell_segments_with_operators, lines 267-274; the `lexer.instream.tell() - len(token)` offset check | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The numeric file-descriptor prefix is not removed for `>|` when the lexer has read and pushed back the following character.
  WHY: For `git push origin 123>|/dev/null`, the offset check misses `>|`, leaving `123` among the parsed Git arguments. Bash treats `123` as the redirect’s file descriptor, so Git pushes the current branch; the guard instead checks branch `123` and can allow the push from a branch whose PR has already merged. The regression test added for `123>|f` expects the prefix to be removed, but this parser logic does not do so.
